note: Dane County's Mendota County Park on the north shore of Lake Mendota in the Town of Westport, near Middleton; the campground sits at the park's north end by County Hwy M, away from the beach. A five-site boat-in camping area is on the shore. --Claude

Not waterfront kept. Website redirects to danecountyparks.com.
